items.q: What's the minimum age for Irvington weed delivery?
items.a_html: Adult-use cannabis delivery in New Jersey requires you to be 21 or older. That applies to placing the order, holding the account, and accepting the delivery at the door. There are no exceptions, and your driver will always verify your ID upon arrival.

items.q: What ID do I need for cannabis delivery in Irvington?
items.a_html: A valid, government-issued photo ID is required. Driver's licenses, state-issued IDs, and passports all qualify, including IDs issued outside of New Jersey. Upload your ID to your Lady L account before placing your first order, and keep the physical ID on hand when your driver arrives.

items.q: Do I need a medical card for delivery?
items.a_html: No medical card is needed. Lady L is an adult-use dispensary, and our delivery service works the same way. If you're 21 or older with a valid ID and an active account, you're good to order. No referral, no prescription, no extra steps.

items.q: How much cannabis can I buy in one delivery order?
items.a_html:
We are allowed to sell up to the equivalent of 28.35 grams (1 ounce) of usable cannabis per transaction. This can be made up of any combination of the following:

  • Dried Flower/Bud: 28.35 grams (1 ounce).
  • Concentrates/Resin/Oils: 4 grams (solid or liquid/vaporized oil).
  • Ingestible Items (Gummies/Edibles): 1,000 mg of THC (roughly ten 100mg packages).
  • Maximum Possession Limit: Up to 6 ounces of cannabis and cannabis products.
  • Mixing Products: You can mix and match, such as purchasing 1/2 ounce of flower and 2 grams of concentrates.
  • Daily Limits: The 1-ounce limit is generally considered a daily limit across all dispensaries.

items.q: What taxes apply to cannabis delivery in Irvington?
items.a_html: Adult-use cannabis purchases in New Jersey include a 6.625% state sales tax, a 2% municipal transfer or user tax where applicable, and a $2.50 per ounce Social Equity Excise Fee (SEEF). These apply to delivery orders the same as in-store purchases. All applicable taxes are shown at checkout before you confirm your order.

items.a_html: Yes. A person 21 or older must be at the address and ready to show a valid government-issued ID when the driver arrives. If nobody's available at delivery time, the order can't be completed. Build your delivery window around a time you know you'll be home.
